python -c "
from glom.core import Check, T
import inspect

# Let's see what attributes Check actually stores
c1 = Check(type=int)
print('type=int:', [a for a in dir(c1) if not a.startswith('_')])
print('  spec:', c1.spec)
print('  default:', c1.default)
print('  validators:', c1.validators)
print('  instance_of:', c1.instance_of)
print('  types:', c1.types)
print('  vals:', c1.vals)

print()
c2 = Check(T['x'], type=str, equal_to='hello')
print('T[\"x\"], type=str, equal_to=\"hello\":', [a for a in dir(c2) if not a.startswith('_')])
print('  spec:', c2.spec)
print('  default:', c2.default)
print('  validators:', c2.validators)
print('  instance_of:', c2.instance_of)
print('  types:', c2.types)
print('  vals:', c2.vals)
"
